title: SQL injection via interpolated tagFilter in tag-list query
description: Verified: api/crud/get.ps1:50 - the tag-list query interpolates the raw query-string value directly into SQL: "...case when [tag] = '$($tagFilter)' then 'selected'...". $tagFilter comes from $WebEvent.Query['tagFilter'] with no parameterization, so a value like x' OR '1'='1 breaks out of the literal. Every other query in the file correctly uses -SqlParameters; this one is a live SQL injection vector.
notes: Coupling: edits api/crud/get.ps1, whose [tag]-table query (get.ps1:50) is removed by audit-codebase-analysis-1783691795-data-model-mismatch (which drops the orphaned feature/tag model). The interpolation is a live injection today, but sequence this after the salvage-vs-rewrite decision so the fix is not applied to code about to be replaced. | Added by feature-review 2026-07-10. | RESOLVED 2026-07-10: Per the approval decision and .aidd/responses.md (the feature/tag demo domain is discarded, not patched), the SQL-injection vector was closed by DELETING the interpolated tag-list query "select [tag], case when [tag] = '$($tagFilter)' ... from [tag]" at get.ps1:59 and its 'tags' response key. No parameterized replacement was added because the demo tag path is being removed as Pantry is modeled fresh. The mustache {{#tags}} filter section in views/components/crudmgr.pode renders empty when the key is absent (no render break). The remaining live query (the [feature] select) already uses -SqlParameters; a repo-wide grep confirms no interpolated SQL remains in get.ps1. Verified headless: AST parse OK, npm test 50/50 passed, PSScriptAnalyzer 0 Error-severity findings repo-wide and none on get.ps1.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. In api/crud/get.ps1, change the tag-list query so the selected-flag comparison uses a bound parameter instead of string interpolation.
2. Use: Invoke-SqliteQuery -DataSource $db -Query "select [tag], case when [tag] = @tagFilter then 'selected' else '' end as [selected] from [tag] order by [tag] asc;" -SqlParameters @{ tagFilter = $tagFilter } -As PSObject
3. Audit the file for any other interpolated SQL and convert all to parameterized queries.
4. Add a Pester test that passes a tagFilter containing a single quote and asserts a normal (non-error, non-injected) response.

approval.decision: Approved. Per .aidd/responses.md: the feature/tag demo domain is discarded � resolve this finding by deleting the demo code path as Pantry is modeled fresh, not by patching it.
